links.comparator_used: Vendor moderation APIs (the abstract does not report a generic-prompt baseline)
links.outcome: Macro F1 for ordinal suicide-severity classification of r/SuicideWatch posts
links.effect: Clinically grounded zero-shot prompting reached 0.562 macro F1, versus 0.395 for vendor moderation APIs
links.quote: Clinically grounded zero-shot prompting recovers much of that gap (0.562 macro F1), and expert-authored framing (not fine-tuning, added reasoning, or naive multi-agent aggregation) is the effective lever.

links.outcome: Severity classification performance, by text register (long noisy Reddit posts vs short clinician-authored statements)
links.effect: Reasoning hurt on long, noisy Reddit posts and helped on short, clinician-authored statements; no numbers given in the abstract
links.tradeoff: Reasoning reduced performance on long, noisy Reddit posts
links.quote: The value of reasoning depends on register: it hurts on long, noisy Reddit posts and helps on short, clinician-authored statements.

design_hint: clinically grounded prompt framing for suicide risk severity
